1812-a-prince-of-bohemia.title: A Prince Of Bohemia
1812-a-prince-of-bohemia.creator: Honore De Balzac
1812-a-prince-of-bohemia.description: A book by Honore De Balzac. “I count the young man in question in that group of our acquaintances which we are wont to style our friends. He comes of a good family; he is a man of infinite parts and ill-luck, full of excellent dispositions and most charming conversation; young as he is, he is seen much, and while awaiting better things, he dwells in Bohemia.

arxiv-2011-11222.title: Improved Confidence Bounds for the Linear Logistic Model and Applications to Bandits
arxiv-2011-11222.creator: Kwang-Sung Jun, Lalit Jain, Blake Mason, Houssam Nassif
arxiv-2011-11222.description: Abstract We propose improved fixed-design confidence bounds for the linear logistic model. Our bounds significantly improve upon the state-of-the-art bound by Li et al. (2017) via recent developments of the self-concordant analysis of the logistic loss (Faury et al., 2020).

arxiv-2101-00727.title: IGM Transmission Bias for z z ≥ \geq 2.9 Lyman Continuum Detected Galaxies 2021 IGM Transmission Bias for z z ≥ \geq 2.9 Lyman Continuum Detected Galaxies – References
arxiv-2101-00727.creator: R. Bassett, E. V. Ryan-Weber, J. Cooke, U. Meštrić, K. Kakiichi, L. Prichard, M. Rafelski
arxiv-2101-00727.description: Abstract Understanding the relationship between the underlying escape fraction of Lyman continuum (LyC) photons ( f esc f_{\rm esc} ) emitted by galaxies and measuring the distribution of observed f esc f_{\rm esc} values at high redshift is fundamental to the interpretation of the reionization process.

arxiv-2107-09483.title: Significant Wave Height Prediction based on Wavelet Graph Neural Network Thanks: This work was partially funded by Natural Science Foundation of Jiangsu Province under Grant No. BK20191298, Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities under Grant No. B200202175.
arxiv-2107-09483.creator: Delong Chen 1 , Fan Liu 1 , Zheqi Zhang 2, *, Xiaomin Lu 1 , Zewen Li 1
arxiv-2107-09483.description: Abstract Computational intelligence-based ocean characteristics forecasting applications, such as Significant Wave Height (SWH) prediction, are crucial for avoiding social and economic loss in coastal cities. Compared to the traditional empirical-based or numerical-based forecasting models, “soft computing” approaches, including machine learning and deep learning models, have shown numerous success in recent years.

arxiv-2208-06806.title: Next-to-leading order QCD predictions for exclusive J / ψ J/\psi photoproduction in ultraperipheral Pb+Pb collisions at the LHC Presented at DIS2022: XXIX International Workshop on Deep-Inelastic Scattering and Related Subjects, Santiago de Compostela, Spain, May 2-6 2022. Speaker: C. Flett.
arxiv-2208-06806.creator: Kari J. Eskola 1,2, Chris A. Flett 1,2, Vadim Guzey, Topi Löytäinen 1,2, Hannu Paukkunen 1,2
arxiv-2208-06806.description: Abstract We present the first study of rapidity-differential cross sections of coherent exclusive J / ψ J/\psi photoproduction in heavy-ion ultraperipheral collisions (UPCs) at the LHC, d ​ σ ​ ( Pb + Pb → Pb + J / ψ + Pb ) / d ​ y \text{d}\sigma(\text{Pb}+\text{Pb}\rightarrow\text{Pb}+J/\psi+\text{Pb})/\text{d}y , to NLO in collinear factorisation.

arxiv-2212-04351.title: Designing with Non-Finite Output Dimension via Fourier Coefficients of Neural Waveforms
arxiv-2212-04351.creator: Jonathan S. Kent
arxiv-2212-04351.description: Abstract Ordinary Deep Learning models require having the dimension of their outputs determined by a human practitioner prior to training and operation. For design tasks, this places a hard limit on the maximum complexity of any designs produced by a neural network, which is disadvantageous if a greater allowance for complexity would result in better designs.

arxiv-2303-07308.title: NeuSE: Neu ral S E(3)-Equivariant E mbedding for Consistent Spatial Understanding with Objects
arxiv-2303-07308.creator: Jiahui Fu, Yilun Du, Kurran Singh, Joshua B. Tenenbaum, John J. Leonard
arxiv-2303-07308.description: Abstract We present NeuSE, a novel Neu ral S E ​ ( 3 ) \text{{S}E}(3) -Equivariant E mbedding for objects, and illustrate how it supports object SLAM for consistent spatial understanding with long-term scene changes. NeuSE is a set of latent object embeddings created from partial object observations.

arxiv-2406-00404.title: The universal property of bordism of commuting involutions
arxiv-2406-00404.creator: Markus Hausmann, Stefan Schwede
arxiv-2406-00404.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Markus Hausmann, Stefan Schwede. We propose a formalism to capture the structure of the equivariant bordism rings of smooth manifolds with commuting involutions. We introduce the concept of an oriented el 2 R ​ O {\el^{RO}_{2}} -algebra , an algebraic structure featuring representation graded rings for all elementary abelian 2-groups, connected by restriction homomorphisms, a pre-Euler class, and an inverse Thom class; this data is subject to one exactness property.

arxiv-2407-06331.title: CharSS: Character-Level Transformer Model for Sanskrit Word Segmentation
arxiv-2407-06331.creator: Krishnakant Bhatt, Karthika N J, Ganesh Ramakrishnan, Preethi Jyothi
arxiv-2407-06331.description: Abstract Subword tokens in Indian languages inherently carry meaning, and isolating them can enhance NLP tasks, making sub-word segmentation a crucial process. Segmenting Sanskrit and other Indian languages into subtokens is not straightforward, as it may include sandhi, which may lead to changes in the word boundaries.

arxiv-2408-02567.title: Geometry via Plane wave limits
arxiv-2408-02567.creator: Amir Babak Aazami
arxiv-2408-02567.description: Abstract . Utilizing the covariant formulation of Penrose’s plane wave limit by Blau et al., we construct for any semi-Riemannian metric g g a family of “plane wave limits.” These limits are taken along any geodesic of g g , yield simpler metrics of Lorentzian signature, and are isometric invariants.

arxiv-2503-13879.title: Bridging Social Psychology and LLM Reasoning: Conflict-Aware Meta-Review Generation via Cognitive Alignment
arxiv-2503-13879.creator: Wei Chen, Han Ding, Meng Yuan, Zhao Zhang, Deqing Wang, Fuzhen Zhuang
arxiv-2503-13879.description: Abstract The rapid growth of scholarly submissions has overwhelmed traditional peer review systems, driving the need for intelligent automation to preserve scientific rigor. While large language models (LLMs) show promise in automating manuscript critiques, their ability to synthesize high-stakes meta-reviews, which require conflict-aware reasoning and consensus derivation, remains underdeveloped.

arxiv-2508-04612.title: A Reproducible, Scalable Pipeline for Synthesizing Autoregressive Model Literature
arxiv-2508-04612.creator: Faruk Alpay, Bugra Kilictas, Hamdi Alakkad
arxiv-2508-04612.description: Abstract The rapid acceleration of research in autoregressive (AR) generative modelling has produced a deluge of publications, making it increasingly difficult for researchers to stay current and reproduce results. Building upon prior survey pipelines, we present a comprehensive and scalable computational pipeline that automatically retrieves, parses, filters, and synthesises literature on AR models.

pmc-10511739.title: Hypoxia-induced ALDH3A1 promotes the proliferation of non-small-cell lung cancer by regulating energy metabolism reprogramming
pmc-10511739.creator: Yang Chen, Hongfei Yan, Lirong Yan, Ximing Wang, Xiaofang Che, Kezuo Hou, Yi Yang, Xuena Li, Yaming Li, Ye Zhang, Xuejun Hu
pmc-10511739.description: Aldehyde dehydrogenase 3A1 (ALDH3A1) is an NAD+-dependent enzyme that is closely related to tumor development. However, its role in non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) has not been elucidated. This study aimed to clarify the mechanism of ALDH3A1 and identify potential therapeutic targets for NSCLC.

pmc-11676714.title: Impact of Diabetes on Excessive Cardiovascular Risk: Matched Analysis Based on the European Health Interview Survey
pmc-11676714.creator: Jenifer Pataki, Gergő József Szőllősi, Cristina Tudoran
pmc-11676714.description: Background and Objectives: Diabetes represents a major public health challenge due to its strong link to cardiovascular risk, therefore the aim was to explore the excessive cardiovascular risk attributed to diabetes. Materials and Methods: This cross-sectional study was based on data from the European Health Interview Surveys in Hungary.

pmc-11781218.title: Attention-aware differential learning for predicting peptide-MHC class I binding and T cell receptor recognition
pmc-11781218.creator: Rui Niu, Jingwei Wang, Yanli Li, Jiren Zhou, Yang Guo, Xuequn Shang
pmc-11781218.description: The identification of neoantigens is crucial for advancing vaccines, diagnostics, and immunotherapies. Despite this importance, a fundamental question remains: how to model the presentation of neoantigens by major histocompatibility complex class I molecules and the recognition of the peptide-MHC-I (pMHC-I) complex by T cell receptors (TCRs).

pmc-12543028.title: Maintenance of memory by negative feedback of synaptic protein elimination: modeling KIBRA–PKMζ dynamics in LTP
pmc-12543028.creator: Harel Z. Shouval, Changchi Hsieh, Rafael E. Flores-Obando, David A. Cano, Tara E. Tracy, Todd C. Sacktor
pmc-12543028.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Long-term activity-dependent modifications of synaptic strength are a cellular substrate of learning and memory, but how long-lasting memory could be based on synaptic proteins that rapidly degrade and diffuse is unknown. Most current theories depend on molecular positive-feedback loops. Recent experiments, however, reveal that interactions between kidney brain protein (KIBRA) and PKMζ downregulate the proteins’ degradation and maintains late-phase long-term synaptic plasticity (LTP) and long-term memory, motivating an alternative model based on negative feedback at the level of protein elimination.

pmc-12737362.title: Booster Vaccination Against Invasive Pneumococcal Disease and Hepatitis B in Previously Vaccinated Solid Organ Transplant Recipients Without Seroprotection
pmc-12737362.creator: Julie Sejerøe-Olsen, Moises Alberto Suarez-Zdunek, Thomas Helbo, Lise Bank Hornung, Charlotte Sværke Jørgensen, Kasper Rossing, Michael Perch, Allan Rasmussen, Sebastian Rask Hamm, Susanne Dam Nielsen, Muhammad Atif Zahoor
pmc-12737362.description: Background: Despite pre-transplantation vaccination against invasive pneumococcal disease (IPD) and hepatitis B virus (HBV), most solid organ transplant (SOT) recipients are without post-transplantation seroprotection against IPD and HBV. We aimed to determine the seroprotection rates and changes in antibody concentrations after booster vaccination against IPD and HBV in SOT recipients without post-transplantation seroprotection after pre-transplantation vaccination.
